title: E-values in the browser: validation of the allmeta E-value page against the R package EValue (reproducibility archive)
description: Reproducibility archive for the allmeta E-value page (allmeta v1.8.0; release DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23515177). The page's own scripts were compared with EValue 4.1.4 (R 4.6.0) on 3,738 preregistered configurations (2,413 from 30 metadat datasets, 1,325 synthetic): 22,428/22,428 checks within 1e-9; planted defects rejected. Version 1.0.1 adds the allmeta main commit 6ce55eb (1/RR marker label for protective effects; not yet in an allmeta release): 22,428/22,428, output identical to the original page, figures re-captured. Run: Rscript --vanilla validate.R.
